five_day_thesis: Spot has advanced $133.9 (+3.02%) from $4,436.6 on 2026-08-17, absorbing a single down session at $4,420 on 08-19 before adding $150.5 across the last two days. The structural story is that nothing rotated — max pain has been frozen at $6,200 for all five sessions, the put wall pinned at $3,500 and the call wall at $8,000 every day, so the entire move happened inside a static OI skeleton rather than against migrating walls. What did move is dealer positioning: window GEX climbed from +467.3 to +651.9 (+39.5%) while never leaving positive territory, and the flip strike drifted up $110 from $3,550 to $3,660 — a long-gamma regime getting deeper, not a regime change. Meanwhile ATM IV expanded 21.89% → 23.15% (+1.26pp), the unusual combination of rising spot and rising implied vol that signals call-side premium being bid rather than fear hedging. Participation confirms it: session call volume has gone 3,227 → 12,610 (3.9x) in five days while put volume only went 1,490 → 3,651, and call OI added 6,007 contracts against 3,341 for puts.
